verdict.rationale: Notte deploys browser automations as serverless Functions, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for it. However, the evidence never mentions function versions, version history, diff or review of changes, or rollback to a prior deployment. Session replays and editable generated code are adjacent features (session playback and a user-side code workflow), not first-party automation versioning or rollback, so they earn no credit.
